topic: 3 questions every customer asks. Could a bot answer them?

hooks.text: Busy shop owners: 3 questions bots answer instantly, no typing.
Small businesses: manual replies vs bots—see which saves more hours.
Entrepreneurs: Myth—bots are robotic. Fact—proper setup feels human.

posts.instagram:
𝗕𝗨𝗦𝗬 𝗦𝗠𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗕𝗨𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗢𝗪𝗡𝗘𝗥𝗦: 𝟯 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗠𝗢𝗡 𝗤𝗨𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦 𝗕𝗢𝗧𝗦 𝗔𝗡𝗦𝗪𝗘𝗥 𝗜𝗡𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧𝗟𝗬, 𝗡𝗢 𝗧𝗬𝗣𝗜𝗡𝗚.

→ 𝗣𝗥𝗜𝗖𝗘, 𝗟𝗢𝗖𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 aur 𝗛𝗢𝗨𝗥𝗦 ke sawal baar‑baar aate hain.
→ Bot turant jawab deta hai, aapka time bachta hai.
→ Setup simple hai, koi deep tech nahi chahiye.

DM 𝗕𝗢𝗧 aur batayein aapke customers kya poochte hain.

posts.linkedin:
A simple chatbot can answer your customers’ routine questions instantly.

Many small businesses spend their day answering the same questions about price, location and opening hours.

A chatbot can reply to those static queries instantly, so you no longer have to type the same answer repeatedly.

It works on WhatsApp or on your website and forwards only the complex questions to a human.

The setup is simple and does not require deep technical knowledge.

You can enter your services, prices and address once, and let the bot handle routine enquiries.

DM BOT to tell me what your customers ask most.
posts.bluesky: 𝗥𝗘𝗣𝗘𝗧𝗜𝗧𝗜𝗩𝗘 𝗤𝗨𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦 A chatbot can answer price, location, and hours automatically so you stop typing the same replies all day. No demo, just a straightforward setup. DM BOT to see if it fits your business.

replies.reply: Hi, thanks for messaging. I build AI chatbots that answer customer questions and take enquiries automatically. Pricing is INR 2,999 or INR 4,999, plus INR 299 per month maintenance. What do you want customers to do—call, WhatsApp, book, or fill a form? I can explain how it would work and give a fixed-price scope. You pay only after you approve the work.

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Hi, thanks for messaging. I help small businesses get more direct enquiries with a simple website plus WhatsApp or chatbot setup. Quick question: is your main problem getting enquiries, converting Instagram followers, or managing leads?

Of course. I can send a one-page summary: what's included, timeline, and price range. Is the hesitation budget, timing, or whether it will actually bring enquiries? If budget is the concern, we can start with a smaller version and expand later. You pay only after you approve the work.

issues: Instagram post targets only shop owners; should address all small businesses.
